pre_change_safeguards: Snapshot all README.md files before modification (readme-before-{family}.md)
Record git status and HEAD SHA before any changes
No changes to files outside owned-files list per lane
abort_conditions: Full test suite drops below 1789 passing → ABORT, revert all changes
README render produces empty or <100 byte output → ABORT that family
readme_facts.py import fails → ABORT (critical dependency broken)
Working tree has unexpected dirty files → STOP, investigate
partial_failure_handling: If one family's backfill fails, other families continue independently
Evidence bundle still produced with partial results
revert_procedure: Do NOT use git reset --hard or git stash
remote_recovery: GitHub API creates PRs atomically — failed API = no partial PR
Wrong README-only PR: close via gh pr close and re-create
All remote operations require explicit approval gates
